answers.core: This can be implemented in an add-on, but core will benefit from it.
answers.workaround: No, as there are *thousands* of diacritics to cater for if you want to strip diacritics in a good way. You also need to replace those accented characters with their non-accented versions.

title: Add a String method to strip diacritics (accents) and return a non-accented String
